changelog: **Relationship-health rules table** (#1898; docs/relationship-health.md). New pure `src/lib/relationHealth.ts`: a versioned (`HEALTH_RULES_VERSION = 1`) table of seven rules — recent contact (against the org's `reminderDays`), stage deadline, answered questions, answered meeting requests, open work, weekly reports in the internship stage, stage movement in 60 days — each with a weight (summing to 100), a window and a one-sentence reason; `scoreRelation()` returns a 0-100 score, a band (HEALTHY ≥70 / WATCH ≥40 / AT_RISK) and the named reasons. A rule with no data drops out of the denominator instead of scoring zero, so a new pair reads healthy; dormant first contacts and non-active relations are excluded. The mentor attention queue (`src/lib/mentorAttention.ts`) now takes its six mentorship reasons from the same table — same reasons, same dormant footnote. Deterministic and published; no model. Foundation for #1901/#1902. Covered by `scripts/test/relation-health.test.mjs` (incl. a doc-sync check).
